gateways.name: Nagano Station
gateways.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen terminus and the primary gateway. Nagano Dentetsu (Nagaden) line to Yudanaka departs from the underground station; Nagano Express Bus departs from East Exit.

gateways.name: Yudanaka Station
gateways.notes: Terminus of the Nagano Dentetsu Yamanouchi Line. ~45 min from Nagano Station; buses to Shiga Kogen and the Snow Monkey Park depart from the station forecourt.

gateways.name: Tokyo Haneda Airport
gateways.notes: Most domestic and regional international flights. ~30 min by Keikyu + JR to Tokyo Station for the Hokuriku Shinkansen onward.

gateways.name: Narita International Airport
gateways.notes: Most long-haul carriers. Allow 1 h Narita Express → Tokyo Station, then 100 min Hokuriku Shinkansen to Nagano.

routes.notes: Hokuriku Shinkansen. Kagayaki is fastest (~85 min); Hakutaka stops at Karuizawa and Ueda.
Yamanouchi Line. The limited express 'Snow Monkey' costs a small surcharge and is much faster than the local.
Shiga Kogen Express direct from Nagano Station East Exit to multiple Shiga sub-resorts (Hasuike, Ichinose, Yakebitaiyama). Reservation recommended.
Local bus winding up to the Shiga Kogen plateau. Combine with the Snow Monkey Park visit en route.
Drops at Kanbayashi Onsen; then a 30-minute walk to the Snow Monkey Park gate.

in_resort_transport.name: Shiga Kogen Sub-Resort Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Free shuttle linking the major Shiga Kogen sub-resorts (Hasuike, Ichinose, Sun Valley, Yakebitaiyama, Okushiga) with a valid Shiga Kogen all-mountain pass.
